ideas.title: Keyboard-first shared chat
ideas.pitch: Compose and retry family turns with the Deck keys.
ideas.experience: A draft survives a weak link; Send never creates a second turn by accident.
ideas.how: Bind text editing to stable turn IDs and the shared authenticated HTTP route.
ideas.risks: Hardware key mapping and partial sends need physical tests.

ideas.title: Wired USB-C reply audio
ideas.pitch: Hear a completed reply through a powered wired headset.
ideas.experience: The Deck plays an approved voice clip with a visible stop control.
ideas.how: Finish the USB audio host path, verify clip identity and bound playback energy.
ideas.risks: ESP32-S3 USB host, power draw and accessory compatibility need bench tests.
ideas.audience: Families who prefer private wired audio

ideas.title: Clear USB recovery steps
ideas.pitch: Make a bad firmware day recoverable.
ideas.experience: A parent sees the exact Deck identity, backup and signed image before any write.
ideas.how: Build a device-aware recovery guide around existing TUF and backup receipts.
ideas.risks: Never erase user state or flash an unverified image.

ideas.title: Store-and-forward radio turns
ideas.pitch: Queue a bounded message until a trusted internet peer can relay it.
ideas.experience: A field message waits locally, then reaches the same family thread once.
ideas.how: Use encrypted envelopes, explicit peer receipts, replay bounds and radio duty limits.
ideas.risks: US915 operation and real power use require hardware validation.

ideas.title: Keyboard-sized Lua apps
ideas.pitch: Give portable games real Deck controls.
ideas.experience: Scout Trail and future apps feel natural with keys, not a stretched watch canvas.
ideas.how: Map shared Lua actions to hardware keys and a readable 320×240 layout.
ideas.risks: App memory and key repeat need on-device testing.
ideas.audience: Kids using the Deck as a pocket computer
